title: Poor Construction
text: Poor Construction. I am not at all impressed with this set of peelers. They are cheaply made. They are sharp, but the handles are so crappy that you can only cut soft veggies with them. Worked good on squash and cucumbers, but fell apart on a small new potato. I would not recommend these to a friend.

product_metadata.title: Swissmar Swiss Trio Peeler Set, Brown, Green and Yellow
features: Includes three peelers: Serrated, Scalpel, and Julienne; each is suitable for right or left handed use
Scalpel peeler is great for thinly peeling hard fruits and vegetables such as apples, carrots and potatoes
Use serrated peeler for more delicate fruits and vegetables such as: tomatoes, mangoes and kiwi.
Julienne peeler creates thin julienne sticks from carrots, zucchini, cucumbers and more
description: This isn't just another peeler set. Proprietary technology from Switzerland has given our Swiss Classic peelers a few new edges. These blades are scalpel sharp - this means less effort to peel and a thinner peel with every stroke. Swissmar's peeler set of three includes: one serrated peeler, one julienne peeler, one scalper peeler. Use the scalpel blade peeler for hard fruits and vegetables such as apples and potatoes. It can also be used to shave hard cheeses and chocolate. The serrated blade peeler is great for more delicate fruits and vegetables such as kiwis, mangoes and tomatoes. Use the julienne blade to create thin julienne sticks on carrots, zucchini, cucumbers and more. Side cutter on each peeler removes eyes and blemishes from produce or can cut grooves in fruits and vegetables. Suitable for left and right handed use, dishwasher safe, Made in Switzerland.
